# Generated ByteArray references

Run `node tests/native-generated-bytearray-reference/run.cjs` and optionally
`--combined`. The complete byteref.Reader AIR subject is emitted unchanged and
compared with fifteen repeated AIR observations on ES5/ES2015 in Node/Chromium.
The suite checks all generated/provider TypeScript diagnostics, eight compiler
rejections, two forged native values and three negative comparison controls.

Admission requires nativeByteArrayReferenceModule with the exact same explicit
ByteArray export in the declaration plan and import map. Method-body unqualified
is/as preserves operand evaluation and uses common nominal as3Is/as3As. ByteArray
returns use the existing reference coercion. Source construction, ancestry,
qualified/shadowed operands, class-initializer tests and arbitrary native member
dispatch are outside this qualification.
